rationale: Pinnacle Gas Services LLC is a distinct operating East Texas midstream platform. The June 15, 2026 transaction closed with Sixth Street-managed Starville acquiring 27% noncontrolling common equity, Quantum/Cactus exiting through redemption, and Comstock retaining 73% and operational control. August 2026 evidence preserved that ownership split, and no later transfer or pending ownership transaction was identified through the cutoff.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Pinnacle Gas Services LLC company record.
Record Comstock Resources through Comstock Gas Services as the active controlling owner from the 2023 platform formation, with 73% disclosed after June 15, 2026.
Record Sixth Street through Starville Evergreen Holdings as an active 27% noncontrolling common-equity owner from June 15, 2026.
Preserve Quantum Capital Solutions/Cactus Midstream as a former preferred-equity owner from 2023 through the June 15, 2026 redemption.
Keep Pinnacle Gas Treating, plants, pipelines and SPVs beneath the manager-level Pinnacle platform; do not treat lenders as owners.
unresolvedQuestions: The post-close LLC agreement and precise entity above Starville are not publicly available.
Exact asset capacity and third-party customer/offtake roster are not publicly disclosed.
No standalone Pinnacle website was identified.
